intro: Который links a description with a noun and is in line with its antecedent in gender and number: книга, которая; письма, которые

bloques.titulo: Который links a description with a noun and is in line with its antecedent in gender and number: книга, которая; письма, которые
texto: Который links a description with a noun and is in line with its antecedent in gender and number: книга, которая; письма, которые
The case depends on the role of который within its own prayer: книга, которую я читаю.

frases.ru: Это дом, который построил мой дедушка.
frases.es: Es la casa que construyó mi abuelo.
frases.en: It's the house my grandfather built.

frases.ru: Мы нашли кафе, которое открыто допоздна.
frases.es: Encontramos una cafetería que abre hasta tarde.
frases.en: We found a coffee shop that opens late.

bloques.pregunta: What complete form «книга, ___ лежит на столе»?

opciones.explicacion: Книга es feminine singular, so it is used которая.
This form does not express the relationship that the question calls for.
Check which word rules the case or the structure.

bloques.frase: Это дом, который построил мой дедушка.

opciones.texto: It's the house my grandfather built.
opciones.explicacion: It corresponds to the first example.

opciones.texto: We found a coffee shop that opens late.
opciones.explicacion: That's the translation of the second example.

bloques.frase: Мы нашли кафе, которое открыто допоздна
bloques.traduccion: We found a coffee shop that opens late.
bloques.explicacion: Look at the order of words and the outstanding grammatical form.
